task.title: To remove the X-Author for Contracts Advanced add-in if you are a Windows user

step.cmd: Go to Files Menu>Options. This opens the Word Options page.
Click Customize Ribbon Menu. Under Customize the Ribbon drop down list, select Main Tabs. The list of Main tabs are displayed.
Select X-Author for Contracts Advanced and click Remove button and click OK. The X-Author Add-in is removed.
